property_summary: For any input, C.proxiableUUID() always returns the ERC-1967 IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT (0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc), but the mutant returns the BEACON_SLOT instead, so it returns a different bytes32 for every input.
change_summary: Return the BEACON_SLOT instead of the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT so proxiableUUID() yields a different bytes32 value.
